title: ProudAuth webhook event envelope (v2)
description: JSON body of a webhook delivery for subscriptions with event_version 2 (EXT-008, EXT-018). Version 2 differs from version 1 in the envelope only; every event type's data members are identical in both versions: (1) the organization member is named organization_id (v1: org_id), the name every data member, the session change stream and the REST API use; (2) payload_form (minimal or standard) states which payload form data is in, so a consumer can tell a member that does not apply from one the minimal form removed; (3) event_version is 2. Delivery, retries, signature headers and the signature scheme are unchanged: the signature scheme is versioned separately (the "v1," prefix of Webhook-Signature) and applies to every event schema version; see envelope.v1.json x-signature for the algorithm and a test vector. Each subscription chooses its event_version (default 1); deliveries are rendered from the stored event by contracts.RenderEvent.

event_id.description: Stable, unique event identifier; equal to the Webhook-Id header. Use it to deduplicate.

event_type.description: Dotted event type, e.g. "organization.membership.removed". Each type has its own <event_type>.v2.json schema.

event_version.description: Event schema version chosen by the subscription. Always 2 for events described by the v2 schemas.

payload_form.description: Payload form of data: minimal (identifiers and classifications only) or standard (every member). Equal to the subscription's payload_form.

occurred_at.description: When the event was recorded, inside the database transaction that made the state change (UTC). Deliveries can arrive out of order; use this and per-resource revisions, not arrival order.

realm_id.description: Realm in which the event occurred. Always present in webhook deliveries (events without a realm are never fanned out).

organization_id.description: Organization the event is scoped to (v1: org_id). Omitted for realm-level events. Organization-scoped subscriptions only receive events whose organization equals their organization_id; realm-wide subscriptions receive all events of the realm.

correlation_id.description: Request ID of the API request that caused the event (the request_id of the matching audit events and the X-Request-Id response header); absent for events caused by background work, except events a lifecycle workflow run causes, which carry the run ID (wrn_...) (API-012).

data.description: Event-type-specific payload; see the per-type schemas. Carries identifiers, states, reasons and timestamps only: never secrets, e-mail addresses or personal names.

event_id.description: Outbox event identifier (ids.Outbox prefix "obx" + lower-case ULID).

client_ref.description: Internal client reference (clients.id), distinct from the OAuth client_id.

role_subject_id.description: Subject of a role assignment: a user (usr_), service principal (svc_) or group (grp_). The prefix identifies the subject type.

grant_subject_id.description: Subject of an authorization grant: a user (usr_) or service principal (svc_).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp as produced by Go's time.Time JSON encoding (fractional seconds when non-zero).

Webhook-Id.description: The envelope's event_id. Identical for every retry and manual replay of the event and for every subscription that receives it.

Webhook-Timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds (decimal integer) at which this delivery attempt was signed. Regenerated on every attempt.

Webhook-Signature.description: Space-separated list of signatures, each "v1," + base64(HMAC-SHA256). The first is computed with the current secret; during the 24 hours after a secret rotation a second one computed with the previous secret follows. Accept the request if any value matches.

x-signature.secret_format: "whsec_" + base64 (standard alphabet, padded; secrets issued before v0.2 are unpadded) of 32 random bytes; shown once at subscription creation and at each rotation
x-signature.key: the 32 bytes obtained by base64-decoding the secret after the "whsec_" prefix
x-signature.signature_encoding: base64, standard alphabet, with padding, prefixed with "v1,"
x-signature.rotation: POST .../webhooks/{id}/rotate-secret issues a new secret; the previous secret keeps signing (second Webhook-Signature value) for 24 hours

test_vector.description: The signature scheme does not depend on the event schema version; use the test vector in envelope.v1.json x-signature.
